title: Regarding Absurd Attempts to Rid Oneself of Waterfowl
author: Infimace-6

file.url: https://www.ifarchive.org/if-archive/games/twine/Regarding Various Absurd Attempts To Rid Oneself of Waterfowl.zip

description:
There's a duck. You were sure you got rid of it yesterday, but here it is again. You gotta do something about it. A short 5-minute silly bit of interactive fiction. Created for Neo-Twiny Jam.
